content.value:
Pick the appropriate graphics presentation for the following applications: 12   
i) Relative enrollment of students in various departments in a university.   
ii) Growth of student strength in a department over a period of 10 years.   
iii) Sales percent of a production in 6 regions of a country.   
iii) Engineering colleges established in different parts of a country.
